title: Trigger-aware UTF-8 and UTF-16 SQL completeness

scope.rationale: The two active completeness APIs share one trigger-aware token state machine and are directly integrated into the public UTF-8 and UTF-16 exports.

external_source_responsibilities: Public process initialization for the UTF-16 export
dependencies.caller_closure: Both active source APIs and their public exports are assigned; UTF-8 and UTF-16 public callers execute the same production state machine.

inputs: Nullable terminated UTF-8 or native UTF-16 SQL text
outputs: Boolean complete/incomplete result or initialization error for UTF-16
contracts.ownership: Input text is borrowed; the production UTF-16 scanner is allocation-free after process initialization.
contracts.state_and_results: Whitespace, operators, quotes, bracket identifiers, comments, ordinary statements, and CREATE TRIGGER ;END; termination preserve the source eight-state transition table.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: Only process initialization may acquire global lifecycle locks; scanning performs no callbacks or I/O.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: NULL and unterminated quote/comment input return incomplete; initialization failure is returned by the UTF-16 API without consuming input.

representation_differences: A generic typed code-unit scanner eliminates the source temporary Mem allocation while retaining successful UTF-16 syntax behavior.

oracle.protocol: Compare UTF-8 and UTF-16 whitespace, semicolon, comment, quote, identifier, ordinary CREATE, EXPLAIN/TEMP TRIGGER, and unterminated inputs.
oracle.normalization: Compare primary public integer results and completion booleans.

assurance.oom: The scanner allocates nothing; UTF-16 process initialization failure is returned before scanning.
assurance.io_crash_concurrency: No I/O or mutable scanner-global state.
assurance.malformed_input: Unterminated comments, quoted tokens, and bracket identifiers return incomplete without over-read.
assurance.continuation: Every call is stateless and independently reusable.
assurance.performance: Linear scan with constant transition-table storage.

integration.native_call_path: sqlite3_complete and sqlite3_complete16 directly invoke the production typed scanner.
integration.bounded_owner_retired: No parallel simplified completeness implementation remains in the public path.

independent_review.notes: Assurance matrix and independent profile review remain open.

known_blockers: Complete malformed UTF-16 and inactive-profile assurance.

implementation_spans: Complete pinned complete.c active bodies and transition table
Native generic scanner, public UTF-8/UTF-16 exports, and differential bridge
callers: Public sqlite3_complete and sqlite3_complete16 API clients
callees: Process initializer and allocation-free completeUnits scanner
assertions_branches_cleanup: All active tokenization branches, trigger transitions, EOF returns, and UTF-16 publication reviewed
upstream_tests: Native complete differential and public phase17 client
